He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball|Northern Kentucky Norse]] and the [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas Razorbacks]]. ==High school career== Tate attended [[Pickerington High School Central]] in [[Pickerington, Ohio]]. He helped his team win three district titles and was a two-time All-[[Ohio Capital Conference]] selection.{{cite web |title=Jalen Tate |url=https://arkansasrazorbacks.com/roster/jalen-tate/ |website=Arkansas Razorbacks |date=6 July 2020 |access-date=March 26, 2021}}{{cite web |last1=Morrow |first1=Jason |title=Senior Sendoff: NKU-bound Jalen Tate is Mr. Versatile! Five-Tool Wing Does It All |url=https://www.270hoops.com/news_article/show/662616-senior-sendoff-nku-bound-jalen-tate-is-mr-versatile-five-tool-wing-does-it-all- |website=270 Hoops |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=June 24, 2016}} In his senior season, Tate averaged 17.2 points, 6.7 rebounds, 3.7 assists and 2.1 steals per game.{{cite web |last1=Purpura |first1=Dave |title=Men's Basketball: Tate helping to lead rise of Norse |url=https://www.thisweeknews.com/sports/20180731/mens-basketball-tate-helping-to-lead-rise-of-norse |website=ThisWeek Community News |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=July 31, 2018}} ==College career== Eight games into his career at [[Northern Kentucky Norse men's basketball|Northern Kentucky]], Tate suffered a season-ending injury, breaking the [[Metacarpal bones|metacarpal]] bone in his left hand against [[Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball|Norfolk State]]. He was granted a medical [[redshirt (college sports)|redshirt]]. As a freshman, Tate averaged 5.7 points, 2.3 rebounds and two assists per game, earning [[Horizon League]] All-Freshman Team and All-Defensive Team honors. He averaged 13.7 points, 4.4 rebounds and 4.1 assists per game as a sophomore and repeated on the Horizon League All-Defensive Team.{{cite web |last1=Ulrey |first1=Jarrod |title=Men's Basketball: Former Pickerington Central duo shine for Northern Kentucky |url=https://www.thisweeknews.com/sports/20200413/mens-basketball-former-pickerington-central-duo-shine-for-northern-kentucky |website=ThisWeek Community News |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=April 13, 2020}} On February 14, 2020, Tate posted a career-high 31 points, seven assists, six rebounds and six steals in an 84–70 win over [[IUPUI Jaguars men's basketball|IUPUI]].{{cite web |last1=Johnson |first1=Robby |title=Tate's 31 points paces @NKUNorseMBB in win over IUPUI, 84-70 |url=https://nkunorse.com/news/2020/2/14/mens-basketball-tates-31-points-paces-nkunorsembb-in-win-over-iupui-84-70.aspx |website=Northern Kentucky University Athletics |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=February 14, 2020}} In his junior season, he averaged 13.9 points, 5.4 rebounds, 3.6 assists and 1.9 steals per game. Tate earned Third Team All-Horizon League honors and was named Horizon League Defensive Player of the Year. He led Northern Kentucky to its second straight [[2020 Horizon League men's basketball tournament|Horizon League tournament]] title and was named tournament MVP.{{cite web |last1=Schutte |first1=Chris |title=Jalen Tate and Northern Kentucky add another Horizon League title to the Norse's growing trophy case |url=https://www.midmajormadness.com/2020/3/11/21174033/jalen-tate-northern-kentucky-horizon-league-championship-darrin-horn-john-brannen |website=Mid-Major Madness |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=March 11, 2020}} For his senior season, Tate moved to [[Arkansas Razorbacks men's basketball|Arkansas]] as a graduate transfer. The Razorbacks finished in the elite eight.{{cite web |title=Vance Jackson, Jalen Tate heading to Arkansas as grad transfers |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/29039599/ex-new-mexico-forward-vance-jackson-heading-arkansas-grad-transfer |website=[[ESPN]] |publisher=[[Associated Press]] |access-date=March 26, 2021 |date=April 15, 2020}} ==Professional career== On October 9, 2021, Tate signed with [[Gießen 46ers]] of the [[Basketball Bundesliga]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.sport1.de/news/basketball/bbl/2021/10/giessen-holt-tate-als-ersatz-fur-alkins-in-die-bbl|title=Gießen holt Alkins-Ersatz|last=|first=|date=October 9, 2021|website=sport1.de|publisher=|language=de|access-date=October 19, 2021}} In December 2025, he signed for [[Gipuzkoa Basket]] of the [[Primera FEB]].{{Cite web |title=JALEN TATE, NUEVO REFUERZO DE
